scope: Read-only static review of the exact updated inactive dependency helper. No execution, tests, host/provider/DB/browser calls, or source edits.

delta_findings.bounded_start_reserve: The initial gate now reserves 1 MiB for bounded repair metadata instead of requiring the already-breached 3 GiB floor before the repair can start.
delta_findings.plan_mode: Plan still enumerates only exact identical eligible dependency files, performs no link/unlink or package-byte mutation, reports planned gain and whether it can meet the admission condition, then exits through its plan receipt.
delta_findings.apply_admission: Apply requires both at least 8 MiB of exact planned allocated-block gain and `free_before + planned_gain >= 3 GiB + 8 MiB`. This covers the reported ~1.5 MiB deficit plus margin without weakening the reserve.
delta_findings.postcondition: After linking, the helper still requires actual free space >= 3 GiB + 8 MiB, exact package file/link manifest integrity, and byte preservation. The 64 MiB maximum and per-inode/per-link/process-reference checks remain.

deployment_gate: The R1 resource blocker is resolved. A plan may now be run read-only; do not apply unless the plan receipt proves the minimum gain and a fresh pre-apply state still satisfies the exact admission equation. Preserve the 3 GiB+8 MiB postcondition and all active-inode guards.
